meta.note: ChEMBL / ClinicalTrials / PubMed records are pulled live and verified. GEO records are seeds pending live E-utilities fetch and are flagged verified=false.

records.title: Ataluren (Translarna, PTC124)
records.description: Small-molecule inducer of ribosomal readthrough of nonsense (premature stop codon) mutations in the DMD gene, restoring dystrophin production. Approved (max_phase 4), first approval 2014, orphan drug, ATC M09AX03.

records.title: Eteplirsen (Exondys 51, AVI-4658)
records.description: Antisense oligonucleotide (phosphorodiamidate morpholino) that induces exon 51 skipping in DMD pre-mRNA to restore the reading frame. First-in-class, approved 2016, ATC M09AX06.

records.title: Givinostat (ITF2357)
records.description: Orally available histone deacetylase (HDAC) inhibitor. First-in-class, approved 2024 for DMD, targeting inflammation and fibrosis downstream of dystrophin loss. ATC M09AX14.

records.title: ASCEND: Phase 1 intrathecal INS1201 gene therapy in ambulatory DMD males
records.description: Phase 1 multicenter open-label study of safety and biodistribution of a single intrathecal injection of INS1201 in ambulatory males with DMD. Sponsor: Insmed Gene Therapy. Recruiting. Enrollment 12; 10 sites.

records.title: Phase 2 of PTC124 (ataluren) for nonsense-mutation DMD
records.description: Phase 2 study of PTC124 as an oral treatment for nonsense-mutation-mediated DMD. Sponsor: PTC Therapeutics. Completed. Enrollment 38; 3 sites. Started 2005.

records.title: Phase 1b multiple ascending oral doses of Rimeporide in DMD
records.description: Phase 1b open-label study of safety, tolerability, PK/PD of multiple ascending oral doses of Rimeporide (NHE-1 inhibitor) in DMD. Sponsor: EspeRare Foundation. Completed. Enrollment 20; 4 sites.

records.title: SUMMIT: long-term safety registry of Vamorolone (AGAMREE) in DMD
records.description: Observational registry of long-term safety of vamorolone (AGAMREE), a dissociative steroid, in DMD. Sponsor: Catalyst Pharmaceuticals. Recruiting. Enrollment 250; 33 sites.

records.title: Heart rate variability in DMD: corticosteroids and betablockers
records.description: Observational characterization of heart rate variability in DMD under deflazacort, prednisone/prednisolone, or no corticosteroids vs typically developing controls. Sponsor: University of Sao Paulo. Completed. Enrollment 40.

records.title: Therapeutic Strategies for Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy: An Update (2020)
records.description: Review of DMD pathogenesis and therapy: mutational spectrum, diagnosis, clinical trials, dystrophin restoration, gene therapy, and myogenic cell transplantation. Genes (Basel).

records.title: CRISPR-Cas9 Gene Therapy for Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (2022)
records.description: Review of CRISPR-Cas9 strategies (base/prime editing) to correct DMD mutations and restore dystrophin in vitro and in animal models; off-target editing, delivery, immune response. Neurotherapeutics.

records.title: Evolving Therapeutic Options for the Treatment of DMD (2023)
records.description: Review of exon skipping antisense oligonucleotides, AAV gene replacement, CRISPR gene editing, and micro-dystrophin gene therapy (incl. Elevidys); lessons and challenges. Neurotherapeutics.

records.title: DMD: promising early-stage clinical trials to watch (2024)
records.description: Overview of Phase I DMD trials from the last 5 years: exon-skipping AONs, gene transfer, inhibitors, small molecules, cell-based therapy, and repurposed drugs. Expert Opin Investig Drugs.

records.title: Duchenne muscular dystrophy: an overview to the cardiologist (2020)
records.description: Review of cardiac evaluation and management in DMD (echocardiography, MRI, dilated cardiomyopathy) as cardiac complications increasingly drive survival. Expert Rev Cardiovasc Ther.

records.title: [SEED] Expression profiling of DMD vs normal skeletal muscle
records.description: Transcriptomic microarray profiling comparing DMD patient skeletal muscle to normal controls. SEED RECORD - accession and metadata pending live verification via NCBI E-utilities; free-text sample annotation typical of GEO.

records.title: [SEED] RNA-seq of dystrophin-deficient muscle stem cells
records.description: Placeholder seed for an RNA-seq dataset of dystrophin-deficient muscle stem cells. NOT YET VERIFIED - the live pipeline resolves and validates the true accession via NCBI E-utilities before this record is trusted. Included to show how unverified sources score lower on FAIR.
